Selective estrogen receptor modulator that competitively inhibits estrogen binding to the estrogen receptors at the hypothalamus and pituitary
•Administered daily for 5 days in the follicular phase, starting between days 3-5
•If ovulation does not occur, dose increased the subsequent month
•Aims to achieve multifollicular ovulation in anovulatory women (
particularly that do not respond to Clomid
) and ovulation in severe mature follicles in other infertile women
•More potent than Clomid and require frequent monitoring of follicle growth;
